Recorded claim:
Part 1 moved the old dialog’s sort into CalendarFileImporter.parseIcsFile so the consolidated about:import wizard receives items in useful order: start date, then entry or due date for tasks, undated items last, with numeric-aware title collation as a tie breaker. Current importer keeps this ordering. This avoids relying on a removed dialog to make imported items intelligible.

Provenance: 1ed40bff62587584e6e723b558910e5e1268df7423f17bb7adda4c4dd3639e60. Original evidence IDs: 54bb7628e87c363f68b755fe78b28e5bdf5433d57997af2bab371d3c575489a0, ed339f78b9d55ee252af1ee2137f6ecd33657f86441bed945ffa924bad121d7c.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
